title: As USS Lincoln heads home, mental health experts tally the stressors of life at sea
summary: The USS Abraham Lincoln is now on its way home after spending nine months at sea. Experts weigh in on the mental-health challenges of prolonged confinement and isolation aboard an aircraft carrier.
contentText:
